openshell: blessed on no live host

Runs in an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox on this host's gateway, through the openshell CLI.

Blessed on
no live host
Default on
no live host
Credentials
held by the venue's egress layer: values with an endpoint are placeholders in the agent; run.secrets go to the job's provider
  • It streams the live transcript and progress only from a job image that declares transcriptStderr and exitAuth.
  • It takes steering messages only from a job image that declares steerStdin, transcriptStderr and exitAuth.
  • It recovers no lost run: run.recover is refused there.
  • It has no sandbox shell: pi-dispatch sandbox cannot reopen its runs.
